desc.zh: 用重叠的三连编号找出所有合格记录，分清编号与日期。
desc.en: Use overlapping ID triples to recover every qualifying visit, even across date gaps.

complexity: O(n log n) time including output sorting (expected hash costs); O(n) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Consecutive-ID triple witnesses
concepts.description: Derive complete runs from overlapping valid triples.

concepts.name: Union invariant
concepts.description: Marked IDs equal the union of all complete triples tested so far.
